representation: Canonical ASCII JSON array of [namespace_uri, local_name, same_expanded_name_ordinal] segments.
serialization: JSON ensure_ascii=true, separators=(',', ':'), no application Unicode normalization.
ordinal_scope: Direct element siblings with the identical BINARY namespace URI/local name.
attribute_identity: Owner element identity plus BINARY namespace URI/local name; source ordinal is separate evidence.
content_identity: Owner element identity, or document identity, plus zero-based canonical direct-content ordinal and kind.
canonical_ordinal: Zero-based within each Tree, sorted by chapter/verse/verse-token ordinal with tree-leaf ordinal as occurrence tie-breaker.
membership: Complete descendant-leaf closure, including a token leaf's self membership; never source Start/End arithmetic.
